analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'wait and see' stance for 3 consecutive days. Both RSI and MACD are consolidating in the neutral zone without a clear direction, and trading volume is subdued at 0.35x the 5-day average, indicating a lack of momentum for trend formation. While the 52-week position at 22% remains low, the current price ($394.59) is between the swing support ($392.32) and swing resistance ($394.65), making it prudent to wait for a directional decision.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($394.59) vs SMA5/20/50 ($388.06/$390.02/$397.93) — Above SMA5/20, below SMA50, indicating short-term upward momentum but below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($398.07)/SMA200 ($432.79) — Below mid-to-long-term trends, entering a weak zone.
· 52-week position (22.0%) + Historical significance of current price range — Recovering from lows but still at a historically low position.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.2→52.5) + Neutral range consolidation — Attempting to break out of oversold and settle in the neutral zone, but lacking directional strength.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.3730→0.8780) + Improvement maintained — Continued improvement in negative territory, but upward momentum is weakening.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $390.02) + Bandwidth 6.18% — Exploring direction while consolidating near the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($392.32) + Basis (based on Pivot S1 $376.63, SMA20 $390.02).
· Swing resistance ($394.65) + Expectation of short-term upward momentum upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Consolidation) + Uncertainty of trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35x) + Decreased reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Explicit condition to wait until directional confirmation.
